modesNote: Color sets ship light, dark and wireframe; scale sets ship desktop and mobile. Desktop is the default; mobile is a platform variant theme extending light (as Polaris light-mobile), not a canonical mode. Wireframe is kept as a native theme. Spectrum ships no increased-contrast set.
